defects: Rank hypothesis is quantified over ALL prime ideals q (Ideal.IsPrime q) instead of only MAXIMAL ideals m as in gold — this is a strictly stronger/different hypothesis (every maximal ideal is prime but not conversely), changing the class of ideals the constant-rank condition ranges over, not a mere restatement
M is required to be only an AddCommMonoid rather than an AddCommGroup as in gold, a weaker/different base typeclass assumption than the gold statement

Uses Module.rank (Cardinal-valued) applied to Localization.AtPrime tensor products instead of gold's rankAtStalk invariant — a different (though plausibly compatible for finite modules) formalization of 'rank at a stalk'
Conclusion is stated via M ⊗[R] Localization.Away a instead of gold's LocalizedModule.Away a M — a different (though likely isomorphic) construction for the localized module
